title: Heavy Rain Alert
description: Very heavy rainfall of {{precipitation}} mm expected around {{location}}. Waterlogging is likely on low-lying roads and underpasses.

title: Thunderstorm & Lightning Warning
description: Thunderstorm cells with lightning expected over {{location}}. Gusts to {{wind}} km/h and brief intense spells are likely.
actions: Shelter indoors for 30 min after thunder

title: Heat Wave Alert
description: Severe heat of {{temperature}}°C expected in {{location}} between 11:00 and 16:00. Heatstroke risk is high for outdoor workers.

title: Poor Air Quality
description: AQI {{aqi}} ({{aqiLabel}}) across {{location}}. Health effects are expected for sensitive groups even during light activity.
actions: Keep windows closed on traffic side

title: Moderate Air Quality Advisory
description: AQI {{aqi}} ({{aqiLabel}}). Unusually sensitive people may experience symptoms with prolonged exertion.

title: Fog Warning
description: Dense fog with visibility {{visibility}} km around {{location}}. Travel at reduced speed with headlights on low beam.
actions: Use fog lights, not high beam

title: Strong Wind Advisory
description: Sustained winds of {{wind}} km/h expected. Loose structures, hoardings and temporary shelters are at risk.

title: Extreme UV Warning
description: UV index {{uv}} at {{timeOfDayLabel}} in {{location}}. Unprotected skin can burn in under 15 minutes.

title: Frost Warning
description: Minimum temperature {{temperature}}°C expected overnight in {{location}}. Standing crops and horticulture are at risk.

title: Snowfall Warning
description: Fresh snowfall expected around {{location}}. Ridge roads and high passes may be closed without notice.

title: School Run Disruption Risk
description: Rain probability {{rainProbability}}% during school hours in {{location}}. Expect gate queues under shelter and a slower commute.

title: Spray Operations Hold
description: Wind {{wind}} km/h exceeds safe drift limits. Chemical application would carry droplets outside the treated block.
actions: Resume when wind drops below 15 km/h
